summary: Preinstall script fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: The package's `scripts.preinstall` runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub, chmods it executable, and uses it to execute a sibling file `math_init.js` — a 727KB `// @bun @bun-cjs` bundle obfuscated with a string-array rotator (`function WV8StW(...) {... MmgoCP.push(MmgoCP.shift())... }` over a large mixed constant table). The loader itself is obfuscated with hex-prefixed identifiers (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`,...) and proxy-object indirection consistent with obfuscator.io transforms. The declared purpose is a Vue dropdown UI component; fetching an alternate JavaScript runtime to execute an opaque bundle at install time is inconsistent with that purpose, and the payload file `math_init.js` is not listed in the package's `files` array yet sits at the tarball root. The alternate-runtime execution path bypasses tooling that inspects only Node-resolved code, so the behavior of the payload cannot be observed statically. Installing this package triggers arbitrary code execution on the installer's host via a runtime the installer did not choose to run.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
